line: Follow the rain from Australia's red desert heart to its green coast in one unbroken painted walk.
line_cn: 跟着降雨从澳洲红色腹地一路画到绿色海岸，一镜到底。

motion.cuts: slow drift, push-through with a focus pull

camera.move: Long lateral dolly over a continuous world
camera.expresses: a gradient; a journey; cause and consequence
camera.serves: a transect; a route; a timeline
a tall tree; a building; a depth
a specimen plate; a recipe; a diagram
a seed; an insect; a hand-written note

camera.move: Pull-back to a map or diagram
camera.serves: where it all happened; a system
a season; forgetting; a new place

camera.move: Page turn / new sheet slides over
camera.expresses: a new entry in the journal
camera.serves: a new day; a new species; a new case

camera.move: Change in time on a locked view
camera.serves: a season cycle; before/after; deep time

transitions: Transitions: brush-edge wipes, mist, a page turn, or a continuous camera move;
no hard video cuts, no dissolves between unrelated pictures.
labels: An elegant serif (e.g. Cormorant Garamond) for titles and subtitles, a handwriting face (e.g. Caveat) for notes, a small mono (e.g. IBM Plex Mono, wide tracking) for measured labels, Noto Serif SC for Chinese (subset to the characters used).
Hand notes are drawn twice over a paper-coloured halo, revealed left to right like writing, with a pen leader line that grows to its specimen.

Subtitles sit on the paper, not in a box: centred at the bottom, serif italic ~36 px (2 balanced lines max), a second-language line beneath at ~2/3 size, ink at ~78 % over a paper-coloured halo. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s).
Numbers are spelled out in the TTS text and written as digits on screen.
motion: Painting-in is the main motion: an object's progress is a function of where it sits on screen or of a cue; strokes in a list each take a slice of that progress, so structure appears first.
Sway only after an object is finished: a small horizontal skew (sin(1.15t+φ) + .4 sin(2.7t+2φ)), ~0.006 for trees, 0.01–0.03 for grass.
Brush-edge wipes: a wavy vertical clip reveals a whole scene; lines grow by stroke progress; labels open with a left-to-right clip.
Mist erases: paper-coloured layers with a wavy rising edge.

native_moves.name: Painting-in as reveal
native_moves.does: A new thing appears stroke by stroke as it enters.
native_moves.fits: the stages of a building; the ingredients of a dish; the organs of a body.

native_moves.name: Burst
native_moves.does: A whole group paints in at once (≤ 1 s) for a peak.
native_moves.fits: a festival crowd; a field in bloom; a city lighting up.

native_moves.name: Palette as data
native_moves.does: Sky, ground and background blend by a measured value.
native_moves.fits: pollution along a river; temperature by altitude; noise across a city.

native_moves.name: Specimen + note
native_moves.does: One hero object with a hand-written label and leader line.
native_moves.fits: a tool kit; a wine region's grapes; parts of a bicycle.

native_moves.name: Mist erase
native_moves.does: The world washes back to paper.
native_moves.fits: forgetting; a dream ending; a site demolished.

native_moves.name: Map in time
native_moves.does: A painted map whose fills change continuously through years.
native_moves.fits: a language spreading; a coastline eroding; a railway network growing.

native_moves.name: Painted transformation
native_moves.does: Objects cross-fade to a burnt, wet or aged sprite and regrow.
native_moves.fits: a wildfire and recovery; a flood; a restoration.
